The motor needs to be replaced, as does the controller board and other components. A bill of $700 for parts and labor. The produce is good but should last longer than 4 years, and there is no excuse for the appalling after sales service. We're going to buy a cheap and cheerful replacement for less than the repair cost, and I'm willing to bet it will last longer than 4 years.

Sentence (English): This is my 4th whirlpool purchase and I am now debating if it worth sticking with them.
Comments (English): [ One year and 12 days ] || ---------------- || This is my 4th whirlpool purchase and I am now debating if it worth sticking with them. I have had people recommend whirlpool over other brands time and time again but honestly I am not sure the quality is there anymore. I have not had any issues with my whirlpool washer and dryer but my fridge has given me me so many issues(not for this review) and I figured it was a fluke until the control bar on my dishwasher started peeling like others who left a review. I purchased on 11/1/2022 so 12 days after the warranty expires the control bar is lifting away from the door. I would like to add that we have used the heated dry function a handful of time at most as I would rather let it run then open the door and let the dishes air dry. I would recommend you stay away from this dishwasher and go with something that will last.

Sentence (English): We purchased our new dishwasher directly from the manufacturer.
Comments (English): [ DO NOT BUY DIRECTLY FROM THE MANUFACTURER ] || ---------------- || We purchased our new dishwasher directly from the manufacturer. We wanted to match our new black stainless KitchenAid double wall oven. I was unable to find the matching dishwasher locally and was pleased with the price online which included free delivery and installation. Buying from KitchenAid directly was a HUGE MISTAKE! We waited over a month for the delivery, there was no way to change an error in the delivery date until a few days before that first date and we lost two more additional weeks waiting for the new date. The delivery was a disaster. KitchenAid uses J.B. Hunt to deliver the dishwasher. J.B.Hunt is a trucking company, they are not an appliance delivery /installation company and the service they provided was absolutely the worst. When the machine arrived the driver was unable to remove the old machine from the cabinet, he said it was installed incorrectly and the cabinet would be damaged and the granite countertop may need to be removed. I accepted the dishwasher and had it placed in my garage because I had such a hard time finding the matching machine. I had to call a kitchen installer to remove the old machine and he had it out in less than 10 minutes with no problems at all. I then waited two more weeks for J.B. Hunt to send someone else for my "free installation." I was very unhappy with the way the machine was installed. It was very poorly installed, it was crooked in two different ways. It was not flush with the counter top and was sitting on a titled angle. It looked terrible and was screwed into my cabinet. Once again I had to call the kitchen company to come and fix the installation at additional cost. So much for free delivery and installation. I will never purchase a kitchen appliance online again. That being said, the dishwasher washes extremely well and is very quiet. It is clearly not made as solid as my old KitchenAid dishwasher which lasted more than 10 years. The racks are not as solid and feel cheap when opened and closed. Our old KitchenAid machine had the option to air dry, which saved electricity and extended the life of the machine, our new machine has no such option, which for me is a big negative. The inside has a third rack but the overall inside is not as large as my old machine (even though they both fit in the same space). It does clean well, I hope it holds up well, but I am worried.

Sentence (English): This is my first time using a dishwasher.
Comments (English): This is my first time using a dishwasher. Since all the appliances in my house are Samsung, I ordered Samsung. The color is Koda Charcoal. Our sink cabinet is a matte, deep gray. It fits perfectly. The delivery guy even complimented me on the matte finish of the Koda, saying the Glam one might look different because it's shiny, but the Koda one looks similar and that I made a good choice. ^^. I live in the countryside, and the area I wanted to install it under the sink is where the boiler line is, so they diagnosed that it could only be installed under the induction cooktop. Furniture Reform came on the scheduled delivery date and diagnosed the problem. The dishwasher was installed the next day. It's 68cm wide, but 8cm of it was unusable. They did a nice job remodeling the furniture. (Remodeling cost 90,000 won.) They said there should be a 2cm gap between the induction cooktop and the dishwasher, so I installed a 2cm induction frame. (The induction frame cost 100,000 won.) The induction cooktop was flush with the sink. It rose 2 centimeters into the air. Anyway, I renovated it on the scheduled delivery date, and they delivered the appliances the next day. They rolled it up in a tissue to see if there were any leaks, and asked me to occasionally touch the tissue and tell them if there were any leaks. They said they only recommend tablet and powder detergents. They don't recommend liquid detergents because they run. The Samsung technician gave me a coupon, so I ordered Ecover tablet detergent at a discount. I also ordered powder detergent. I plan to use the tablets for large, oily items without cutting them. I ordered powder detergent for interior cleaning or smaller items (citric acid or vinegar are recommended for interior cleaning). You can adjust the amount. I ordered both types, and they seem great. Samsung doesn't give detergent with dishwasher orders. If you order the dishwasher and order the detergent right away, you can use it right away. It's a little noisy, but I can't hear it when I'm lying in my room after dinner and running the dishwasher. It's not because the dishwasher is using hot water from the boiler. It cleans with hot water running on electricity. Each time you run it, it costs about 100 to 150 won. If you run it once a day, it's about 3,000 won a month. Isn't this how you hire cheap people? I understand why, aunt. I've been using it for a few days and am writing a review. It's so convenient. ^^. I just remove the right amount of rice residue and run it. It washes cleanly, as always. Clothes dryer, dishwasher, robot vacuum. Aunt. The dishwasher was my last purchase. I should have bought it sooner. You won't regret it. I ordered mine for 600,000 won, and the reform frame for 190,000 won. Gray tone. If it's under the sink, go with Glam Charcoal if it's glossy, or Koda if it's not. You can order it. If my review was helpful, please click "Helpful." ^ . ^. I recommend it. ^~^
Comments (Original): 식기세척기는 처음사용하는데요 ~집에 가전이 죄다 삼성꺼여서 삼성으로 주문함.색상은 코다차콜인데요.저희. 씽크대 하부장이 진 그레이 톤 매트한 제질인데찰떡임돠.배송온 기사도 글램으로 하면 광이나서 달라보일수있는데 코다로 주문하니 매트한 제질이라.비슷해보여 잘 주문했다고. 칭찬하더라구요^^여기는 지방인데요씽크대 밑에 설치하고 싶은 곳은 보일러 선이 있고인덕션 밑 부분에만 설치 할 수 있다고 진단 내려 주셨어요배송 예정일에 가구리폼 오셔서 진단해주시고바로 다음날 식세기. 설치가로68 센치. 인데 8센치는 못쓰는곳 으로가구 이쁘게 리폼 해 주시고 (리폼비 구만원 )인덕션과 식기세척기 간격이 2cm 공간이 있어야한다고 하여인덕션2cm. 프레임 설치 했어요 (인덕션 프레임 십만원)인덕션이 씽크대와 일치형 이였는데공중으로 2센치 떳네요.여튼 배송 예정일에 리폼,다음날 가전 배송 해주셨어요물이 새는지 휴지로 말아 놓고간간히 휴지를 만져보고 새는지 말해달라고 하네요타블렛세제, 가루형 세제만 권장 한다고 하네요액상형 세제는 흘러 내림때문에 권장안한다고합니다.저는삼성 기사님이 쿠폰 주셔서 에코버 타블렛 세제 저렴히 주문 했고가루형 세제도 주문했어요타블렛을 양많고 기름기 많을때,자르지 않고 쓸려고요가루세제는. 내부세척 하거나, 적은양 세척 할때쓸려고 가루세제 주문 (내부세척시 구연산 또는 식초 좋다고합니다.)양 조절도 가능.두가지 타입으로 주문했는데 좋은거 같아요삼성에서는 식기세척기 주문하면 세제를안줌니다.세척기 주문 하시고,세제를 바로 주문 하시면 바로 사용 할 수 있습니다.소음은 조금 있는데요 저녁먹고 식세기 돌리고. 방에 누워있는데 안들려요ㅋ보일러 온수로 세척이 되는게 아니라전기로 온수나와서 세척이 되어요.한번돌릴때 마다 백원에서 백 몇십원 정도전기료. 나간다 합니다 하루 한번돌리믄한달에 삼천원' 꼴 ㅋ이정도 이모님 이믄 저렴히 사람 쓰는거 아닌가요?3대 이모님 왜 그런지 알겠어요한 몇일 사용 하다 후기 올리는데너무 편해요^^적당히 밥풀정도 제거 하고 돌리는데뽀득하니 여태껏. 깨끗히 씻겼어요의류건조기,  식기세척기, 로봇청소기 3대이모님 식세기가 젤 마지막으로 샀네요진작살껄요후회안하십니다저는 육십만원대로 주문, 리폼프레임 십구만원정도로 주문했어요그레이톤.씽크대 하부장 이믄 광이 있다면 글램차콜, 광이 없다면 코다쪽으로주문하시면 될꺼에요제 리뷰가 도움이 된다면 ㅡ '도움이 돼요 '  눌러쥬세요 ^  .  ^추천합니다 ^~^

Sentence (English): Our sink cabinet is a matte, deep gray.

The delivery guy even complimented me on the matte finish of the Koda, saying the Glam one might look different because it's shiny, but the Koda one looks similar and that I made a good choice. ^^. I live in the countryside, and the area I wanted to install it under the sink is where the boiler line is, so they diagnosed that it could only be installed under the induction cooktop. Furniture Reform came on the scheduled delivery date and diagnosed the problem. The dishwasher was installed the next day. It's 68cm wide, but 8cm of it was unusable. They did a nice job remodeling the furniture. (Remodeling cost 90,000 won.) They said there should be a 2cm gap between the induction cooktop and the dishwasher, so I installed a 2cm induction frame. (The induction frame cost 100,000 won.) The induction cooktop was flush with the sink. It rose 2 centimeters into the air. Anyway, I renovated it on the scheduled delivery date, and they delivered the appliances the next day. They rolled it up in a tissue to see if there were any leaks, and asked me to occasionally touch the tissue and tell them if there were any leaks. They said they only recommend tablet and powder detergents. They don't recommend liquid detergents because they run. The Samsung technician gave me a coupon, so I ordered Ecover tablet detergent at a discount. I also ordered powder detergent. I plan to use the tablets for large, oily items without cutting them. I ordered powder detergent for interior cleaning or smaller items (citric acid or vinegar are recommended for interior cleaning). You can adjust the amount. I ordered both types, and they seem great. Samsung doesn't give detergent with dishwasher orders. If you order the dishwasher and order the detergent right away, you can use it right away. It's a little noisy, but I can't hear it when I'm lying in my room after dinner and running the dishwasher. It's not because the dishwasher is using hot water from the boiler. It cleans with hot water running on electricity. Each time you run it, it costs about 100 to 150 won. If you run it once a day, it's about 3,000 won a month. Isn't this how you hire cheap people? I understand why, aunt. I've been using it for a few days and am writing a review. It's so convenient. ^^. I just remove the right amount of rice residue and run it. It washes cleanly, as always. Clothes dryer, dishwasher, robot vacuum. Aunt. The dishwasher was my last purchase. I should have bought it sooner. You won't regret it. The delivery guy even complimented me on the matte finish of the Koda, saying the Glam one might look different because it's shiny, but the Koda one looks similar and that I made a good choice. ^^. I live in the countryside, and the area I wanted to install it under the sink is where the boiler line is, so they diagnosed that it could only be installed under the induction cooktop. Furniture Reform came on the scheduled delivery date and diagnosed the problem. The dishwasher was installed the next day. It's 68cm wide, but 8cm of it was unusable. They did a nice job remodeling the furniture. (Remodeling cost 90,000 won.) They said there should be a 2cm gap between the induction cooktop and the dishwasher, so I installed a 2cm induction frame. (The induction frame cost 100,000 won.) The induction cooktop was flush with the sink. It rose 2 centimeters into the air. Anyway, I renovated it on the scheduled delivery date, and they delivered the appliances the next day. They rolled it up in a tissue to see if there were any leaks, and asked me to occasionally touch the tissue and tell them if there were any leaks. They said they only recommend tablet and powder detergents. They don't recommend liquid detergents because they run. The Samsung technician gave me a coupon, so I ordered Ecover tablet detergent at a discount. I also ordered powder detergent. I plan to use the tablets for large, oily items without cutting them. I ordered powder detergent for interior cleaning or smaller items (citric acid or vinegar are recommended for interior cleaning). You can adjust the amount. I ordered both types, and they seem great. Samsung doesn't give detergent with dishwasher orders. If you order the dishwasher and order the detergent right away, you can use it right away. It's a little noisy, but I can't hear it when I'm lying in my room after dinner and running the dishwasher. It's not because the dishwasher is using hot water from the boiler. It cleans with hot water running on electricity. Each time you run it, it costs about 100 to 150 won. If you run it once a day, it's about 3,000 won a month. Isn't this how you hire cheap people? I understand why, aunt. I've been using it for a few days and am writing a review. It's so convenient. ^^. I just remove the right amount of rice residue and run it. It washes cleanly, as always. Clothes dryer, dishwasher, robot vacuum. Aunt. The dishwasher was my last purchase. I should have bought it sooner. You won't regret it. I ordered mine for 600,000 won, and the reform frame for 190,000 won. Gray tone. If it's under the sink, go with Glam Charcoal if it's glossy, or Koda if it's not. You can order it. If my review was helpful, please click "Helpful." ^ . ^. I recommend it. ^~^
Comments (Original): 식기세척기는 처음사용하는데요 ~집에 가전이 죄다 삼성꺼여서 삼성으로 주문함.색상은 코다차콜인데요.저희. 씽크대 하부장이 진 그레이 톤 매트한 제질인데찰떡임돠.배송온 기사도 글램으로 하면 광이나서 달라보일수있는데 코다로 주문하니 매트한 제질이라.비슷해보여 잘 주문했다고. 칭찬하더라구요^^여기는 지방인데요씽크대 밑에 설치하고 싶은 곳은 보일러 선이 있고인덕션 밑 부분에만 설치 할 수 있다고 진단 내려 주셨어요배송 예정일에 가구리폼 오셔서 진단해주시고바로 다음날 식세기. 설치가로68 센치. 인데 8센치는 못쓰는곳 으로가구 이쁘게 리폼 해 주시고 (리폼비 구만원 )인덕션과 식기세척기 간격이 2cm 공간이 있어야한다고 하여인덕션2cm. 프레임 설치 했어요 (인덕션 프레임 십만원)인덕션이 씽크대와 일치형 이였는데공중으로 2센치 떳네요.여튼 배송 예정일에 리폼,다음날 가전 배송 해주셨어요물이 새는지 휴지로 말아 놓고간간히 휴지를 만져보고 새는지 말해달라고 하네요타블렛세제, 가루형 세제만 권장 한다고 하네요액상형 세제는 흘러 내림때문에 권장안한다고합니다.저는삼성 기사님이 쿠폰 주셔서 에코버 타블렛 세제 저렴히 주문 했고가루형 세제도 주문했어요타블렛을 양많고 기름기 많을때,자르지 않고 쓸려고요가루세제는. 내부세척 하거나, 적은양 세척 할때쓸려고 가루세제 주문 (내부세척시 구연산 또는 식초 좋다고합니다.)양 조절도 가능.두가지 타입으로 주문했는데 좋은거 같아요삼성에서는 식기세척기 주문하면 세제를안줌니다.세척기 주문 하시고,세제를 바로 주문 하시면 바로 사용 할 수 있습니다.소음은 조금 있는데요 저녁먹고 식세기 돌리고. 방에 누워있는데 안들려요ㅋ보일러 온수로 세척이 되는게 아니라전기로 온수나와서 세척이 되어요.한번돌릴때 마다 백원에서 백 몇십원 정도전기료. 나간다 합니다 하루 한번돌리믄한달에 삼천원' 꼴 ㅋ이정도 이모님 이믄 저렴히 사람 쓰는거 아닌가요?3대 이모님 왜 그런지 알겠어요한 몇일 사용 하다 후기 올리는데너무 편해요^^적당히 밥풀정도 제거 하고 돌리는데뽀득하니 여태껏. 깨끗히 씻겼어요의류건조기,  식기세척기, 로봇청소기 3대이모님 식세기가 젤 마지막으로 샀네요진작살껄요후회안하십니다저는 육십만원대로 주문, 리폼프레임 십구만원정도로 주문했어요그레이톤.씽크대 하부장 이믄 광이 있다면 글램차콜, 광이 없다면 코다쪽으로주문하시면 될꺼에요제 리뷰가 도움이 된다면 ㅡ '도움이 돼요 '  눌러쥬세요 ^  .  ^추천합니다 ^~^

Comments (English): This is my first time using a dishwasher. Since all the appliances in my house are Samsung, I ordered Samsung. The color is Koda Charcoal. Our sink cabinet is a matte, deep gray. It fits perfectly. The delivery guy even complimented me on the matte finish of the Koda, saying the Glam one might look different because it's shiny, but the Koda one looks similar and that I made a good choice. ^^. I live in the countryside, and the area I wanted to install it under the sink is where the boiler line is, so they diagnosed that it could only be installed under the induction cooktop. Furniture Reform came on the scheduled delivery date and diagnosed the problem. The dishwasher was installed the next day. It's 68cm wide, but 8cm of it was unusable. They did a nice job remodeling the furniture. (Remodeling cost 90,000 won.) They said there should be a 2cm gap between the induction cooktop and the dishwasher, so I installed a 2cm induction frame. (The induction frame cost 100,000 won.) The induction cooktop was flush with the sink. It rose 2 centimeters into the air. Anyway, I renovated it on the scheduled delivery date, and they delivered the appliances the next day. They rolled it up in a tissue to see if there were any leaks, and asked me to occasionally touch the tissue and tell them if there were any leaks. They said they only recommend tablet and powder detergents. They don't recommend liquid detergents because they run. The Samsung technician gave me a coupon, so I ordered Ecover tablet detergent at a discount. I also ordered powder detergent. I plan to use the tablets for large, oily items without cutting them. I ordered powder detergent for interior cleaning or smaller items (citric acid or vinegar are recommended for interior cleaning). You can adjust the amount. I ordered both types, and they seem great. Samsung doesn't give detergent with dishwasher orders. If you order the dishwasher and order the detergent right away, you can use it right away. It's a little noisy, but I can't hear it when I'm lying in my room after dinner and running the dishwasher. It's not because the dishwasher is using hot water from the boiler. It cleans with hot water running on electricity. Each time you run it, it costs about 100 to 150 won. If you run it once a day, it's about 3,000 won a month. Isn't this how you hire cheap people? I understand why, aunt. I've been using it for a few days and am writing a review. It's so convenient. ^^. I just remove the right amount of rice residue and run it. It washes cleanly, as always. Clothes dryer, dishwasher, robot vacuum. Aunt. The dishwasher was my last purchase. I should have bought it sooner. You won't regret it. I ordered mine for 600,000 won, and the reform frame for 190,000 won. Gray tone. If it's under the sink, go with Glam Charcoal if it's glossy, or Koda if it's not. You can order it. If my review was helpful, please click "Helpful." ^ . ^. I recommend it. ^~^

I live in the countryside, and the area I wanted to install it under the sink is where the boiler line is, so they diagnosed that it could only be installed under the induction cooktop. Furniture Reform came on the scheduled delivery date and diagnosed the problem. The dishwasher was installed the next day. It's 68cm wide, but 8cm of it was unusable. They did a nice job remodeling the furniture. (Remodeling cost 90,000 won.) They said there should be a 2cm gap between the induction cooktop and the dishwasher, so I installed a 2cm induction frame. (The induction frame cost 100,000 won.) The induction cooktop was flush with the sink. It rose 2 centimeters into the air. Anyway, I renovated it on the scheduled delivery date, and they delivered the appliances the next day. They rolled it up in a tissue to see if there were any leaks, and asked me to occasionally touch the tissue and tell them if there were any leaks. They said they only recommend tablet and powder detergents. They don't recommend liquid detergents because they run. The Samsung technician gave me a coupon, so I ordered Ecover tablet detergent at a discount. I also ordered powder detergent. I plan to use the tablets for large, oily items without cutting them. I ordered powder detergent for interior cleaning or smaller items (citric acid or vinegar are recommended for interior cleaning). You can adjust the amount. I ordered both types, and they seem great. Samsung doesn't give detergent with dishwasher orders. If you order the dishwasher and order the detergent right away, you can use it right away. It's a little noisy, but I can't hear it when I'm lying in my room after dinner and running the dishwasher. It's not because the dishwasher is using hot water from the boiler. It cleans with hot water running on electricity. Each time you run it, it costs about 100 to 150 won. If you run it once a day, it's about 3,000 won a month. Isn't this how you hire cheap people? I understand why, aunt. I've been using it for a few days and am writing a review. It's so convenient. ^^. I just remove the right amount of rice residue and run it. It washes cleanly, as always. Sentence (English): The Bosch did not come with the necessary electrical hook-ups.
Comments (English): [ The Bosch experience. ] || ---------------- || The Bosch did not come with the necessary electrical hook-ups. Before I ordered the dishwasher, I talked to a Costco concierge about the need for "Hook-ups." I was assured that the dishwasher came with everything it needed. That was a big uneducated guess on her part. The only "Hook-up" that came with the machine was a plug-in wire! Learn from my experience! I had the added cost of the kit and the further delay waiting for it before I could install the machine. The Bosch is a great dishwasher. I would buy it again BUT just beware that you will need to buy the electrical kit!

Sentence (English): We replaced some kitchen appliances with this dishwasher, the double oven range and fitting microwave hood.
Comments (English): [ Rusting after three months! ] || ---------------- || We replaced some kitchen appliances with this dishwasher, the double oven range and fitting microwave hood. We opted again for KitchenAid instead of trying a German brand which we had also looked into.We take good care of our appliances and our trusted oven was about 20 years old when we parted. But it was time for sure. Well, three months, and a few thousand dollars later, I am not excited anymore; I actually feel like an idiot having been so proud and happy about this investment. This is a lot of money for us. The stainless steel is rusting away after just four months. Rust has formed on the corners of the dishwasher door, hinges, around the nice LED light indicator window, the hinges, and the screws which connect the stainless steel sheet surrounding the outside of the door. (I will not even get into the issues with the oven range.)Such issues never even occurred with the inexpensive appliances in our old rental.And it looks so very cheap and ugly! KitchenAid used inadequate materials/manufacturers while advertising its trusted, higher-end quality standard! I dreamed of being able to afford a KitchenAid appliance when I was a young wife with little kids. We are active military with over 20 years in. Relocating regularly gave us our fair share of having to make it work with some questionable kitchen appliances over the years. I am not complaining about that at all. But now, what are we supposed to even do? Get the dishwasher and the expensive range exchanged for the same pieces? We are in a lose-lose situation with the money budgeted for appliances gone.This makes me kind of angry because I feel like we were taken advantage of. ( Sorry ) How much more research can one do? Unrelated: The microwave hood combo works great by the way! Zero complains there! Love it. This was a long review. My apologies.

Sentence (English): We had a dishwasher (not Bosch) a few years back that had constant problems.
Comments (English): [ A dishwasher so nice, we bought it twice ] || ---------------- || We had a dishwasher (not Bosch) a few years back that had constant problems. It would error out for more cycles than actually was the dishes. After replacing the same $150 part for the sixth time, we did research on a replacement and found this dishwasher. One of the features I love is the very top, small things tray. This holds the silicone cup toppers our preschooler uses. It's great for serving spoons and grabber tongs. Things that benefit from laying down in the wash. The trap is super easy to clean. On the old machine, the trap was not accessable for a weekly cleaning. We run the dishwasher about four or five times a week and being able to give the filter a quick wash is important. And when you can access it easy, it's a job that I don't mind doing. The dishes always look clean after the wash - except for dishes with peanut butter or shredded cheese. Those two foods like to bake onto the dishes rather than was away. I'm in the habit of giving those dishes a little more pre-wash attention. Why did we buy it twice? We moved. We left our appliances in our old home when selling. Whe we moved, the house had a dishwasher that worked well, but it wasn't the Bosch that I had grown to love. What would I change? Not much. The one thing about our new model that the old one didn't do is that it's wi-fi connected. I've never needed to remotely start or stop an appliance, but I like getting the ping alert that the cycle is finished. We have an LG washer that does this, too. The ap has you name your appliance, so the washer is called Gerry Lee Laundry Butler. That ap alerts me "Gerry Lee has finished your laundry." (Or something similar. ) The Bosch ap has you name the appliance also. So I called the dishwasher Scullery Maid - but the ap doesn't use the name. it says, "Program Complete Dishwasher The program is complete." Why give your appliance a name if your application isn't going to use it? I think the ap needs a little creative rewriting for its alerts. I don't have any complaints about this dishwasher. It's dependable and quiet.

Sentence (English): *** This is a freestanding (built-in) product. **.
Comments (English): [ It's freestanding ] || ---------------- || *** This is a freestanding (built-in) product. **. This product is based on the basic base product called DW60A8575FG, and the model name varies depending on the front panel color. I purchased the Glam White color, which is the original color of Samsung appliances, and it is the DW60A8575LWS. This DW60A8575FG is a freestanding (built-in) product that originally came with a countertop and a mop holder. To install it as a built-in, you need to remove the countertop and mop holder and remodel the sink. I don't understand why the Coupang customer service representative kept insisting it wasn't freestanding. If you go to the official Samsung Electronics website and enter the product number, it says it's freestanding. Anyway, it's a freestanding product, and that's how I installed it. Let me tell you about my purchase experience. First, I was disappointed by the laxity of the pre-installation technician. When the pre-installation technician came and looked at my house, he immediately said, without even looking, that freestanding installation was not possible. The reason was that the door threshold was lower than 8cm. I was flustered by the recent trend of removing thresholds, and we argued a bit. I said I understood, and when they asked me to provide the work manual with the relevant threshold regulations, I told them I'd look it up at the office on the first day of work. Five minutes later, they rang the doorbell, apologized, said they hadn't been aware of the changed regulations, and changed their stance, saying they would proceed with the installation according to the schedule. They had been adamant about not allowing freestanding installations. The installation was completed today, and the Samsung installation technician's service was extremely satisfactory. Even though I had requested the installation over the phone during work, they had already completed the installation perfectly when I got home. I was initially skeptical of Samsung's handling of the pre-installation process, but the technician's handling of the installation was truly remarkable. My first impressions were as follows: They briefly spun the Venta disk. My impression was, "Oh, it's ruined." They said the PP material was heat-resistant, but the Venta LW-45 disk deformed. It was heartbreaking. A Naver search said the glass mode wouldn't exceed 55 degrees Celsius, making it safe. But even in glass mode, this happened. What could have gone wrong? Why did I get a strong plastic-like smell as soon as I opened the dishwasher door? It was so unpleasant that I wondered if I could even put my eating utensils in it. It's heartbreaking because I used an expensive Venta dishwasher, but I'll take it as an experience. I'm trying to convince myself that the plastic smell will go away with enough running. Moving is a mixed bag, but I hope this review helps those of you considering purchasing this product.
Comments (Original): [ 프리스탠딩 됩니다 ] || ---------------- || *** 프리스탠딩 (빌트인 겸용) 제품입니다 **이 제품은 DW60A8575FG 라는 기본 베이스 제품에 앞판 색상에 따라 모델명이달라집니다. 전 삼성가전 원래 맞추었던 글램화이트 색상으로 구매해 DW60A8575LWS 입니다.이 DW60A8575FG 는 원래 상판과 걸레받이가 포함되어 프리스탠딩 (빌트인 겸용)으로 나온제품입니다.빌트인으로 설치하려면 상판 걸레받이 탈거 후 싱크대 리폼해서 설치하는것이에요.왜 쿠팡 상담사가 끝까지 프리스탠딩 아니라고 하는지 모르겠어요. 삼성전자 공식 홈페이지가서 품번넣으면 프리스탠딩이라고 나옵니다.무튼 프리스탠딩 되는 제품이고, 그렇게 설치했습니다.제품 구매경험에 대해 말씀드릴게요.첫번째로 사전 방문 기사의 업무에 대한 느슨함이 아쉬어요.사전설치 기사님이 와서 집 보자마자 뭐 더 보지도 않고 첫마디가  프리스탠딩 설치 불가입니다. 였습니다.이유는 문턱이 8cm보다 낮아서... 였구요. 요즘 문턱 없애는 추새인데 너무 당황했고 다소 언쟁이 있었지만 일단 알겠다고하고 해당 문턱 규정 나온 업무 매뉴얼 달라고라니 업무개시일에 사무실에서 찾아보겠다고하고 돌아갔습니다. 5분뒤에 바로 초인종 누르더니 규정 바뀌었는데 몰랐다고 사과하고 일정에 따라 설치 진행하겠다고 입장 변화했습니다. 그렇게 완강히 프리스탠딩 안된다하시더니 말이죠.그렇게 금일 설치 마쳤고 삼성 본설치 기사님 서비스는 “최고만족”이었습니다. 업무중이라 유선상으로 요청사항 말씀드렸음에도 퇴근하고 와보니 완벽하게 해놓으셨네요. 사전기사 업무에서 삼성이 왜이렇게 주먹구구지 했는데, 본설치 기사님 업무처리에서 아 이게 삼성이지 했습니다.첫 개시 작동 소감은 일단 잠깐 벤타 디스크를 돌려봤는대요.소감은 “아 망했다”입니다.PP 재질이라 열에 강다하더니 벤타 LW-45 디스크 변형왔어요. 너무 가슴 아프고... 네이버 검색 시 유리잔 모드하면 55도 안넘어서 안전하다했는데, 유리잔모드였음에도 이렇게 되었네요. 뭐가 문제 였을까요. 어째 식세기 문 열자마자 진한 플라스틱 사출향이 나더라니... 찝찝해서 먹는 식기를 넣어도 되나 싶어요.벤타 디스크 비싼대 해먹어서 가슴 아프지만 경험이라 생각하겠구요. 플라스틱 냄새는 열심히 돌리다보면 없어지겠지 정신승리하려합니다.이사와 동시에 제 마음은 여러모로 혼돈이 가득합니다만 이 제품 구매해시려는 여러분들 선택에 이 리뷰가 도움이 되기를 바랍니다.

Sentence (English): As someone who absolutely hates washing dishes among all housework, I vowed to install a dishwasher in our new home no matter what.
Comments (English): [ A dishwasher for 6 people is enough for a 2-person household! ] || ---------------- || As someone who absolutely hates washing dishes among all housework, I vowed to install a dishwasher in our new home no matter what. I initially planned to get a 12-place setting model, but due to limited space, I opted for a 6-place setting instead, and I am very satisfied! Every evening, I throw in the day's pile of dishes, pans, pots, and cups, and run it without any issues! In fact, on days with less dishwashing, it feels a bit awkward to run it, so I end up using more dishes just for fun. There are a few downsides, though: 1. You must pre-wash. I use Frosh detergent, but it doesn't wash out greasy or burnt-on food. So I pre-wash them before putting them in, but it is a bit unpleasant because water drips down while I'm putting them in the dishwasher while they are still wet. 2. The dishwasher is noisy, and there is some noise when draining the water. In particular, the water comes out all at once with a gurgling sound, which sometimes gives me a scare. 3. Sentence (English): I came from 10 years of high end kitchenaid dishwashers, and had a pretty rotten time with the last one.
Comments (English): [ It might be perfect? ] || ---------------- || I came from 10 years of high end kitchenaid dishwashers, and had a pretty rotten time with the last one. went through 4 circ pumps, a few heating elements and some other nonsensical issues in less than 5 years. Had a friend or three raving about Bosch so I grabbed an 800 series. Man do I love this crazy thing. First off, they really did a ridiculously nice job with the design. The third rack has a sort of V shape to it, so weird shaped plastic spatulas and whatnot actually fit up top. This also allows really tall cups to fit on the second rack towards the edges, which my last 3 rack dishwasher couldn't do and it made me nuts. The most hilarious "the future is NOW" feature is the "quadrants" of the bottom rack. Let's say you put a giant filthy pot in the upper left section of the bottom rack. you can go on the app and highlight it and tell the dishwasher to spend extra time and effort in that sector. I purposely put a ridiculously dirty marinara crusted megapot down there and told the app to absolutely HAMMER that section and it came out squeaky clean. I couldn't stop laughing. Who thinks of this stuff? It's also dead quiet, but so is everything in this price range so no surprises there. The only real concern I have is everything appears to be sealed in the unit. The Kitchenaids were fairly easy to work on if you're even moderately handy. You could drop a wear and tear item like a $20 heating element in the beast in 15 minutes. I'm not sure this thing can be worked on at home by handy guys / gals. Hopefully we don't need to worry about that for a long time. Overall I love it and hope it lasts forever and ever.

Sentence (English): Everything seemed fine with the delivery but when I went to install, I noticed the new dishwasher was delivered without an insulation blanket.
Comments (English): Everything seemed fine with the delivery but when I went to install, I noticed the new dishwasher was delivered without an insulation blanket. I have installed 6 dishwashers, and they all came with insulation blankets and every installation video I have watched all had the blankets. We called customer service to find out what we were supposed to do. The customer service said she would have to call GE to find out what to do. After talking to GE she told us the insulation blanket was supposed to be on the unit. She said that unfortunately we could not just have an insulation blanket delivered but would have to have a whole new dishwasher sent to replace the one we received and that it would take approximately 10 days to have another one delivered. This was hard to understand but I assumed it was something to do with warranty? The new dishwasher was finally delivered and low and behold no insulation blanket. Unfortunately, I was not able to be home to sign for the delivery and asked my son to be there and he made the mistake of signing and accepting the delivery. When he told us that there was no blanket, we once again called customer service. This time when the customer service rep called GE they said that this particular model does not come with an insulation blanket and that since we ordered it online we could not return it. We got our old insulation blanket from our old unit and wrapped this new unit because the rep did not even offer information on where to purchase a new blanket. I cannot believe that this one model did not come with the insulation blanket. The Home Depot customer service department was not helpful, and GE has not followed up with our concerns. We will never buy any appliance online again from Home Depot.

Sentence (English): I knew that I wanted a Bosch since I had heard many good things about the brand.
Comments (English): [ Quality dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I knew that I wanted a Bosch since I had heard many good things about the brand. The hard part was deciding which one. The selling point for me was that this one has 3 shelves and fit even my large sized plates. The top shelf is used for odd sized utensils like spatulas, large mixing spoons etc. There are a number of washing cycles but I mainly use the auto clean. If the dishes are not dry enough you can adjust the amount of drying agent to use on each load via the app. Yes its Wi-Fi enabled and in order to customize the programs or check on different settings, you need to use the app. Once its set though, youre good. It is a very quiet machine also. I was told by the salesperson that this model was built in Germany, and that not all Bosch machines are made in the same countries. I also like that the wire racks can be adjusted to suit different types of pots, plates, etc. Would I buy the same one again, yes I would. Weve had it for a month now and are happy with it.

Sentence (English): A few years ago, we got this dishwasher based on the glowing Wirecutter review.
Comments (English): [ Good dishwashing in a cheapo package ] || ---------------- || A few years ago, we got this dishwasher based on the glowing Wirecutter review. Our previous dishwasher came with the house and lasted at least 10 year. After only a few years with the Bosch, we need to replace it because repairing it would not cost effective. A few months ago, the the scopp-shaped handle cracked while opening the washer. The crack goes all the way through the plastic, and it will be a matter of time until the piece breaks off. The chrome colored edge of the handle is chipping, which is more evidence that Bosch chose a cheap construction. Even if I did the replacementmyself, the part is so expensive that we'd rather buy a new dishwasher. We have no complaints when it comes to the cleaning abilities. Different detergents give you different results but when you go with good name brands, your dishes come out clean and shiny. One gripe is that they over-advertise the washer's ability to accommodate stemware. Our wine glasses (name brand, nothing fancy or overly tall) don't fit the top rack even when it is lowered fully. They need to go on the bottom rack but there is nothing that would hold them in place well. Bosch offers an accessory, but that should have been part of the package.Opting for plastic to cut costs is undersandable but not for the part that gets used the most.

Comments (English): [ Good dishwashing in a cheapo package ] || ---------------- || A few years ago, we got this dishwasher based on the glowing Wirecutter review. Our previous dishwasher came with the house and lasted at least 10 year. After only a few years with the Bosch, we need to replace it because repairing it would not cost effective. A few months ago, the the scopp-shaped handle cracked while opening the washer. The crack goes all the way through the plastic, and it will be a matter of time until the piece breaks off. The chrome colored edge of the handle is chipping, which is more evidence that Bosch chose a cheap construction. Even if I did the replacementmyself, the part is so expensive that we'd rather buy a new dishwasher. We have no complaints when it comes to the cleaning abilities. Different detergents give you different results but when you go with good name brands, your dishes come out clean and shiny. One gripe is that they over-advertise the washer's ability to accommodate stemware. Our wine glasses (name brand, nothing fancy or overly tall) don't fit the top rack even when it is lowered fully. They need to go on the bottom rack but there is nothing that would hold them in place well. Bosch offers an accessory, but that should have been part of the package. Opting for plastic to cut costs is undersandable but not for the part that gets used the most.

Sentence (English): We bought this to replace our old leaking dishwasher and it's sooo much better!
Comments (English): [ Amazing Features, Lots of Space, Thorough Cleaning ] || ---------------- || We bought this to replace our old leaking dishwasher and it's sooo much better! We were in the market for a 3rd-rack dishwasher and this one had the deepest one. We love the spray tubes that rotate under the 3rd rack, it's surprisingly effective and saves us a lot of space for bowls and small plates on the 2nd rack. With a family of 5 we go through a lot of dishes quickly, so this has been used a lot since we purchased it a month ago. I tested each of the cycles with our usual full load of dirty dishes and we found this to work the best for us: Express Wash, no prewash, with rinse aid, and heated dry. It actually gets the dishes spot free clean and dry in about 2 hours with less detergent than our old washer! Plus its really quiet, we can only hear it when the pump is draining water into the disposer. The only cons I can come up with are my own troubles during installation, but it had nothing to do with the dishwasher itself.

Sentence (English): I wanted to love this machine, it works great, racks are very sturdy and smooth, cleans really well and dries well too.
Comments (English): [ Too bad for GFCI ] || ---------------- || I wanted to love this machine, it works great, racks are very sturdy and smooth, cleans really well and dries well too. It was actually pretty quiet. The 60 min wash is where its at, but any other option the cycles get long. All dishwashers do now though. The issue for me was it kept tripping my GFCI outlet. Had 2 electricians check things out, breakers, wires and outlet. Put in new GFCI outlet. Problem persisted. Replaced the LG with another same model, same thing started tripping the outlet again. From LG when I asked: \"GFI compatibility: LG dishwashers, including the LDTH7972S model, are not recommended to be used with GFI outlets. The brushless DC motor and inverter board in these dishwashers can cause fluctuations in power draw that may trip a GFI.\". Full text can be found in questions following this link.  so rather than switching to non GFCI outlet, I went with Bosch. But I really liked the LG . when it was not tripping the outlet. The other negative for me was the bottom rack has only 4 rows of tines, so smaller plated especially if square are tricky. Great silverware basket especially next to the Bosch. Hard to recommend, but hard not too.

Comments (English): [ Good Dishwasher, Bad User Interface ] || ---------------- || If I could use all basic features of this dishwasher purely from the control panel, this would be a five star review. It's solidly constructed, cleans really well, and it's quiet. The only non-UI complaint I have is that the inset handle feels flimsy and cheap because it flexes a lot when you pull the door open. As it stands though it's a 3 star review. It's really more 3.5 stars but that's not an option so 3 it is. There are too many basic features locked inside the app. The app should be an option to use as an interface, but I should be able to make full utilization of my rather expensive dishwasher when my phone is dead, the internet is out, or if I just don't want to use the app at the moment. The app should only enable features that you can't reasonably accommodate on the physical control panel, like the concentrated cleaning options they have. Plus, what if they kill the server hosting the app in 10 years? Want to set a delay on the wash? Well that's only in the app. Press power and then remote connect on the control panel, then open the app, wait for it to connect, select the cycle and delay, and hit start. Oh, you opened the dishwasher and added another item? Close the dishwasher, get out your phone, open the app, wait for it to connect, and press start again. It's real annoying doing that a half dozen times in an evening. Other things like a rinse only cycle are only available in the app. I eventually figure out a workaround for the delay in the app where I can just set it to run at midnight every night with "My schedule" feature and then you can just hit the "play" button on the control panel each time you open and close it instead of having to open the app every single time, but you do still have to start the cycle from the app each time for the initial start. Their support helped me figure that out. They do have good support. Even then though, it required some experimentation on my end to figure out how to make sure it runs if you open the door after starting the cycle in the app. Also, why does it not come with the 90 degree elbow for the supply line? It's a required item, no way around it; but I had to make another trip to Lowe's once I discovered this. Also, if you're replacing an existing dishwasher that was direct wired, be aware you'll need to wire in an outlet or get a kit from Bosch to direct wire it. Finally, make sure you look at the documentation in the app. There's a user manual in the app that's way more complete than any of the printed documentation included with the dishwasher. The installation instructions have you run a short test cycle to check for leaks and cancel it after just a few minutes. However, nowhere in the printed documentation does it tell you how to cancel a cycle nor is there a cancel button. If you look in the PDF user manual in the app, it will tell you though.

Sentence (English): Purchased this dishwasher directly from KitchenAid's website.
Comments (English): [ Very frustrating start ] || ---------------- || Purchased this dishwasher directly from KitchenAid's website. I installed it the day after it arrived and I could immediately tell there was something wrong with the wash pump. It was entirely too loud. I called KitchenAid and asked about exchanging it for another and they told me that they need to send out a technician to fix it because otherwise mine would just get sent to the trash. I reluctantly agreed and when their contracted repair person showed up, he tested the pump with his volt meter and basically told me that it doesn't matter how loud it is, if it's washing properly then he can't replace it. He called KitchenAid while still here and told them that the pump was functional in his opinion.I called KitchenAid after he left and the agent told me that now that I've had it serviced, they cannot replace it. What? I asked for replacement the first time and was told no. At that point I had threaten to file a dispute with my credit card company for receiving a defective unit. Only then was I transferred to a supervisor who ordered a replacement for me. It arrived a few days later, I installed it and it is MUCH quieter than the first one. I'll be replacing my oven and cook top in the next 6 months or so and this has convinced me to never buy from the KitchenAid website. I haven't absolutely ruled out purchasing KitchenAid appliances but whatever I buy will be from a local brick and mortar store where I hope that I can get some support when there's a problem. I did purchase an extended warranty from KitchenAid for this dishwasher so I'm a little concerned about what will happen if this dishwasher ever needs service inside that warranty window.As far as the dishwasher itself, it does a pretty good job of cleaning. I like left side of the third rack where I can put small glasses or bowls. The utensil side of the third rack is a little frustrating. The handle for it is right in the middle of the rack, making it so that I have to position utensils around it. Seems like they should have put finger tip grips on the ends instead of a handle right in the middle. The very bottom rack is basically made to hold a complete set of dinner plates for like 10 people or something. There's little thought about putting pots and pans anywhere in the dishwasher. That doesn't seem to be unique to KitchenAid, it seems like every dishwasher we looked at was only concerned with how many plates it could fit. I often times end up just removing the silverware holder so I can get more room on the bottom rack. I wish the silverware holder could split in half so that I could take only half of it out when I'm trying to fit pans in.

I called KitchenAid and asked about exchanging it for another and they told me that they need to send out a technician to fix it because otherwise mine would just get sent to the trash. I reluctantly agreed and when their contracted repair person showed up, he tested the pump with his volt meter and basically told me that it doesn't matter how loud it is, if it's washing properly then he can't replace it. He called KitchenAid while still here and told them that the pump was functional in his opinion.I called KitchenAid after he left and the agent told me that now that I've had it serviced, they cannot replace it. What? I asked for replacement the first time and was told no. At that point I had threaten to file a dispute with my credit card company for receiving a defective unit. Only then was I transferred to a supervisor who ordered a replacement for me. It arrived a few days later, I installed it and it is MUCH quieter than the first one. I'll be replacing my oven and cook top in the next 6 months or so and this has convinced me to never buy from the KitchenAid website. I haven't absolutely ruled out purchasing KitchenAid appliances but whatever I buy will be from a local brick and mortar store where I hope that I can get some support when there's a problem. I did purchase an extended warranty from KitchenAid for this dishwasher so I'm a little concerned about what will happen if this dishwasher ever needs service inside that warranty window.As far as the dishwasher itself, it does a pretty good job of cleaning. I like left side of the third rack where I can put small glasses or bowls. The utensil side of the third rack is a little frustrating. The handle for it is right in the middle of the rack, making it so that I have to position utensils around it. Seems like they should have put finger tip grips on the ends instead of a handle right in the middle. The very bottom rack is basically made to hold a complete set of dinner plates for like 10 people or something. There's little thought about putting pots and pans anywhere in the dishwasher. That doesn't seem to be unique to KitchenAid, it seems like every dishwasher we looked at was only concerned with how many plates it could fit. I often times end up just removing the silverware holder so I can get more room on the bottom rack. I wish the silverware holder could split in half so that I could take only half of it out when I'm trying to fit pans in.

Sentence (English): I implore you not to buy this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Overpriced Garbage ] || ---------------- || I implore you not to buy this dishwasher. Never in my life did it occur to me I would have to verify a dishwasher came with a heated drying cycle. After all, even a 329.00 slumlord special has a heated drying cycle. Imagine my delight when after the install and first load, we realize the “drying cycle” is nothing more than the door popping open at the end of the cycle and letting nature (residual steam) kick in and take its course….certainly not what I expect from a higher end dishwasher or any dishwasher….I was literally in shock pouring through the manual looking for the clues I had missed something.Nothing like being dressed to the nines on your way out the door to dinner, thinking, “Hey! I'll be productive by unloading the dishwasher before I head out” and being sloshed with water from the slightly concave bottoms of your coffee mugs (water that you hope to God is clean but are now fully skeptical of due to your initial impression of this mastery of engineering)….all 4 of the mugs that you could reasonably fit in the top rack.Next point, the interior layout. It stinks. I hope you're not a beverage or full size dinner plate person. The real estate is very poorly designed. Nothing efficient about it. The silverware baskets are way too shallow and cause items like butter knives to fall over. This leaves you with using the top tier slide out layer for flatware. Some people may love this. I don't. I often forget it is there and neglect to unload this area, wondering why we have a fork shortage in our home.The only nice feature? The “half load” setting. And the showstopper? The icing on the cake if you will? The drain pump died after only 16 months. I prayed the fix would be more than it was, as I wanted so badly to cut my losses and move on. But in this inflation-centric economy, I simply couldn't make peace with tossing the thing so soon.And since it's a Bosch, the rest of it will probably last forever…. here's hoping. queue bitter laughter.Just don't do it. If you love to dry your own dishes a la Little House on the Prairie, have at it, but I don't buy dishwashers to have to perform this extra task. Nothing else about it is redeeming enough to make up for this major flaw.

Sentence (English): (This review was collected as part of a promotion.)
Comments (English): [ Very quiet machine ] || ---------------- || (This review was collected as part of a promotion.) It has been about 3 months since I bought this machine. It is a good one in general. But I can not stop comparing this one with the last machine--- an Asko dishwasher, which was a great one and kept working in place for about 20 years, Amazing! right.1. Overall layout design: The New KitchenAid has three levels of racks compared with two of the old Asako which is helpful to lay out the stuff that needs to be washed.2. Noisy level: 39dBA of the new one is very very quiet compared with the old one. You can barely hear the sounds if you are several meters away from the machine. Very impressive! 3. Function wise: A: The washing power (cleanness) is not as good as the old one. Maybe this is the shortcoming of the quietness of the machine while working. B: Dryness is below the bar according to my experience. There are always water drops and moisture in the machine upon each washing matter which wash cycle I choose to wash the dishes, wine/beer wares, and other culinary stuff. C: There is no special design for wine/beer glass (to hold or keep glassware stable in place during the washing cycle. This is very important also for safety concerns. If the glass is broken, people may get hurt. also, it is terrible when you can see water drops in the glass wall after washing.I understand it is unfair to compare this machine with a much more expensive Asako one. But something needs to be taken into consideration in a dishwasher design. Most of them as fundamental requirements for any dishwasher while I may expect this machine to function well for twenty years! I miss my pannel-ready Asko dishwasher. I wish KitchenAid could design and release more pannel-ready dishwashers. (The current KitchenAid model is too deep for mine,)
